query: For my 68-year-old male inpatient with acute pancreatitis, among male inpatients aged 63–73 with AP, what is the 90th percentile of the 72‑h lab‑instability score? For patients ≥P90, report mortality, mean LOS, and per‑lab critical rates versus general inpatients.
final_sql: SELECT ap_patients.deathtime, ap_patients.los, p90_patients.p90_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labevents WHERE labevents.itemid = 720571 AND labevents.charttime BETWEEN ap_patients.admittime AND ap_patients.dischtime AND labevents.value > p90_patients.p90_value) AS critical_lab_events, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labevents WHERE labevents.itemid = 720571 AND labevents.charttime BETWEEN ap_patients.admittime AND ap_patients.dischtime AND labevents.value <= p90_patients.p90_value) AS stable_lab_events FROM ap_patients JOIN p90_patients ON ap_patients.subject_id = p90_patients.subject_id;
